question.question:
A borrower's loan agreement limits dividends to two baskets. Builder basket capacity equals 40% of cumulative net income for years 1-4 minus prior distributions of 30 USD million, floored at zero. Year 1 net income is 35 USD million; pre-charge net income grows 10% per year, compounding, in years 2-4. Year 2 only is reduced by a one-off after-tax charge of 50 USD million; a resulting loss year reduces cumulative net income. A general basket of 12 USD million is usable regardless of leverage. The borrower requests a dividend of 35 USD million; the proposed payment is the lesser of the request and the sum of both baskets. Builder basket use is blocked if pro forma net leverage after paying the full proposed payment from cash strictly exceeds 3.00x, where net leverage is (gross debt of 310 USD million minus cash) divided by EBITDA of 100 USD million and cash before payment is 75 USD million; a ratio exactly equal to 3.00x passes. If blocked, only the general basket may be used, again limited by the request. Report the permitted dividend in USD million.

Answer format: return only the exact numeric value interpreted in `usd_million`, using finite-decimal notation when it terminates in base 10 and an irreducible `numerator/denominator` fraction otherwise, with no unit label or additional text.

slots.description: Sum of years 1-4 net income including the charge-reduced year 2
Builder basket capacity after prior distributions and zero floor
Net leverage after paying the full proposed payment from cash
Whether the leverage block on the builder basket applies
